privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: G-TEC Education Thodupuzha ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.infoWeCollectContent: We may collect personal identification information (name, email address, phone number, educational qualifications, employment history), demographic information, and usage data when you fill out enquiry forms, register as a student, create a candidate profile, or register as an employer.
privacy.howWeUseContent: We use the collected information to provide and maintain our services, process enquiries and registrations, match candidates with employers, communicate with you about your account, and improve our website and services.
privacy.dataSharingContent: We may share your information with registered employers (for job seekers and students who have enabled profile visibility), with service providers who assist us in operating our website and services, and as required by law. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.dataRetentionContent: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacy.yourRightsContent: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You can update your profile information through your account settings. To request account deletion, please contact the centre.
privacy.contactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact G-TEC Education Thodupuzha at the centre address listed on our website or via the contact form.

terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Welcome to G-TEC Education Thodupuzha. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
terms.servicesContent: G-TEC Education Thodupuzha provides education and training services (courses, certifications, placement support), a student portal with academic resources, and a job portal connecting candidates with employers.
terms.userAccountsContent: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. You agree to provide accurate and complete information when creating an account or using our services.
terms.candidateBiodataContent: By creating a candidate profile, you consent to your profile being visible to registered employers as described in our Privacy Policy. You can control your profile visibility through your account settings at any time.
terms.employerObligationsContent: Employers agree to use candidate information solely for legitimate hiring purposes, maintain confidentiality of candidate data, and not use the platform for any unlawful or discriminatory practices.
terms.prohibitedUsesContent: You agree not to use the website or services for any unlawful purpose, to impersonate any person or entity, to interfere with or disrupt the website, or to collect user information without consent.
terms.limitationOfLiabilityContent: G-TEC Education Thodupuzha shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of your use of the website or services.
terms.contactContent: For questions about these Terms, please contact G-TEC Education Thodupuzha at the centre address listed on our website or via the contact form.
